nodes.label: Portal Locked Art Fix
nodes.source_location: ## 1. Fix: locked vs. unlocked portal art
nodes.rationale: Locked and unlocked portal art were visually indistinguishable; a code-side stopgap (dark tint + lock glyph) was added, but proper distinct art is preferred for clear player progression feedback.

nodes.label: Prop Icon Removal Rationale
nodes.source_location: ## 2. No longer needed: prop icons as in-scene overlays
nodes.rationale: Floating prop icon sprites were removed from MemoryScene because full painted backgrounds already depict the objects, making the overlay a jarring duplicate. Props are now shown only in the Asset Gallery in the BTS room.

nodes.label: Optional Title Screen Art
nodes.rationale: Main menu reuses garden-bg dimmed, which looks good enough. A bespoke title-bg key could be wired into assetManifest if desired but is not blocking.

nodes.label: Character Consistency Technique
nodes.rationale: ChatGPT image generation does not guarantee consistent characters across prompts. Technique: generate a model sheet first, then upload it as reference for each outfit variant within a single running conversation thread per character.

nodes.label: Canvas Resolution Fix (320x180 to 1280x720)
nodes.rationale: The game was rendering at 320x180 and upscaling 4-6x with nearest-neighbor filtering, causing blur. Fixed by rendering at 1280x720 with smooth filtering. Source assets also need higher native resolution to stay sharp at the larger canvas.

nodes.label: Cozy Date Night Filename Bug
nodes.rationale: her-cozy-date-night.png and him-cozy-date-night.png are byte-identical to the outfit reference sheets, indicating the reference sheet was saved under the wrong filename. These two files need to be regenerated properly.
